title: Hidayat al-Qari short version: selected sections
attribution: Geoffrey Khan, The Tiberian Pronunciation Tradition of Biblical Hebrew, Volume 2, Hidāyat al-Qāriʾ (Short Version), Open Book Publishers, 2020, https://doi.org/10.11647/OBP.0194.03, CC BY 4.0.
changes: Selected only sections II.S.0.1–II.S.0.2 from publisher’s embedded PDF text; normalized line breaks, removed printed line number 5, moved the S20:1r manuscript reference to the manifest, and rendered footnote 1 inline in the English. No OCR and no new translation. Source and English segments follow the editor’s matching section labels. Added sections II.S.0.4–II.S.0.5: corrected a PDF font extraction of “off”, removed printed line numbers 15 and 20, and moved the S9:1v manuscript reference to this manifest. At that stage, section II.S.0.3 was not included. Added II.S.0.3 from the publisher’s embedded text across facing pages: joined page continuations, removed printed line number 10 and moved S9:1r to this manifest, corrected two font-extracted “first” ligatures, restored quotation placement at five Hebrew/English boundaries, and normalized Unicode compatibility forms. No OCR or new translation. Added II.S.1.5–II.S.1.6 from embedded PDF text, moving extracted combining dots to their printed letters, restoring spaces at Hebrew/English boundaries and removing printed line number 40. No OCR or new translation.

sections.englishFootnote: Literally: the book of the lifeblood.

sections.editorialCorrections: Restored PDF-font ligatures in “first”, normalized Unicode, and repaired five Hebrew/English quotation boundaries.

sections.corrections: Restored the PDF-extracted combining dot to the last Hebrew letter and restored the space before English.
Restored PDF-extracted combining dots to the final Hebrew letters and restored spaces before English.

limitations: Seven selected sections of the short Judeo-Arabic version with Khan’s English translation: II.S.0.1–II.S.0.5 and II.S.1.5–II.S.1.6. Sections II.S.1.1–II.S.1.4 and the remainder are not included; alignment with the separate medieval Hebrew translation has not been independently checked.
verification: Compared the two embedded-text extracts with rendered source pages; no OCR. Source edition is partial and the CC license does not itself verify all distribution conditions.
